name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.35 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
